title: Product Fields

fields.label: Gallery image
fields.name: gallery_image
fields.instructions: Main product gallery image.

fields.label: Gallery thumbnails
fields.name: gallery_thumbnails
fields.instructions: type=placeholder renders the template's fallback 'FPO IMAGE' label for slots that don't have a real image or video yet.

sub_fields.label: Type
sub_fields.name: type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose what this thumbnail slot shows.

sub_fields.label: Video URL
sub_fields.name: video_url
sub_fields.instructions: Used when Type is Video. Full URL (https://…), a site path (/products/) or an in-page anchor (#section-id).

fields.label: Quick facts
fields.name: quick_facts
fields.instructions: e.g. '35+ years in neurosurgery • Used in 40+ countries'.

fields.label: Family pill
fields.name: family_pill
fields.instructions: Optional — leave empty for base-variant products (e.g. Sugita II has no pill). Plain free-text field, not derived from the product_configuration taxonomy term.

fields.label: Model line
fields.name: model_line
fields.instructions: e.g. 'Part no.: FB-0480 • Available in 6 sizes'.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.instructions: Product description.

fields.label: Spec table caption
fields.name: spec_caption
fields.instructions: Optional table caption. Leave empty to render no caption.

fields.label: Spec rows
fields.name: spec_rows
fields.instructions: Add one row per spec table line.

fields.label: Has size guide
fields.name: has_size_guide
fields.instructions: Enable to show the blade-size selector + size-guide table on this product.

fields.label: Size selector label
fields.name: size_selector_label
fields.instructions: e.g. 'SELECT BLADE SIZE'.

fields.label: Size selector part no.
fields.name: size_selector_part_no
fields.instructions: Updates alongside the selected size.

fields.label: Size guide heading
fields.name: size_guide_heading
fields.instructions: e.g. 'SIZE GUIDE'.

fields.label: Size guide badge
fields.name: size_guide_badge
fields.instructions: e.g. '6 sizes available'.

fields.label: Size guide column 1 header
fields.name: size_col_1
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Blade Width'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Size guide column 2 header
fields.name: size_col_2
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Part number'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Size guide column 3 header
fields.name: size_col_3
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Blade length'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Size guide column 4 header
fields.name: size_col_4
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Compatible handle'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Size guide column 5 header
fields.name: size_col_5
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Typical application'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Size rows
fields.name: size_rows
fields.instructions: The size dropdown's options are derived from these rows' Width values at render time, not duplicated as a separate field.

sub_fields.label: Default selected
sub_fields.name: is_selected
sub_fields.instructions: Marks which size row is the default-highlighted one.

fields.label: Has instruments table
fields.name: has_instruments_table
fields.instructions: Enable to show the 'Instruments Included' parts-list table on this product.

fields.label: Instruments heading
fields.name: instruments_heading
fields.instructions: e.g. 'Instruments Included'.

fields.label: Instruments badge
fields.name: instruments_badge
fields.instructions: e.g. '15 Instruments • 21 pieces'.

fields.label: Instruments download label
fields.name: instruments_download_label
fields.instructions: e.g. 'Download full parts list'.

fields.label: Instruments parts-list file
fields.name: instruments_file
fields.instructions: PDF behind the download link. Leave empty to hide nothing (link falls back to #download-parts-list).

fields.label: Instruments column 1 header
fields.name: instruments_col_1
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. '#'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Instruments column 2 header
fields.name: instruments_col_2
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Instrument'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Instruments column 3 header
fields.name: instruments_col_3
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Part number'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Instruments column 4 header
fields.name: instruments_col_4
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Qty'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Instruments column 5 header
fields.name: instruments_col_5
fields.instructions: Table header, e.g. 'Notes'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Instrument rows
fields.name: instrument_rows
fields.instructions: Add one row per included instrument.

sub_fields.label: Notes
sub_fields.name: notes_col
sub_fields.instructions: Optional — several rows are empty in the source, must render cleanly when blank.

fields.label: Accessories heading
fields.name: accessories_heading
fields.instructions: Section heading, e.g. 'ACCESSORIES'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Accessories
fields.name: accessories
fields.instructions: Add one tile per accessory.

sub_fields.label: Product
sub_fields.name: product
sub_fields.instructions: Most accessory targets don't resolve to a real product yet — leave empty until that product exists; no placeholder post is invented.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional override for the tile subtext when it doesn't match the linked product's own model_line.

sub_fields.label: Image override
sub_fields.name: image_override
sub_fields.instructions: Optional — falls back to the linked product's gallery_image when empty.

fields.label: Related products heading
fields.name: related_heading
fields.instructions: Section heading, e.g. 'RELATED PRODUCTS'. Empty = template default.

fields.label: Related products
fields.name: related_products
fields.instructions: Add one tile per related product.

fields.label: Testimonial quote
fields.name: testimonial_quote
fields.instructions: Testimonial quote copy.

fields.label: Testimonial name
fields.name: testimonial_name
fields.instructions: Placeholder pass-through verbatim ('Prof Name Here, MD PhD') on the example products — highest-priority content to confirm with the client.

fields.label: Testimonial department
fields.name: testimonial_dept
fields.instructions: Placeholder pass-through verbatim.

fields.label: Buttons
fields.name: buttons
fields.instructions: CTA buttons shown under the spec table and in the testimonial band (first = solid, second = outline with the download arrow).

description: Plain field group for the m11_product CPT (single-product template, fixed section order) — no common_settings/two-tab FC convention, per decision_record q9.
